overview_description.description:
Our mission at Credal is to harness frontier AI for everyone building a better future.
We’ve built the industry’s highest ceiling and most secure Action & Agent building platform for sticky, custom AI workflows and we accelerate the most complex, sophisticated operations of the most impactful institutions, while weaving security and governance into every part of our product.
Use cases span countless domains, including: KYC, anti-money laundering, healthcare regulation, climate standards setting, cybersecurity, sales, people, IT, and customer support and our customers include the U.S. Dept of Health and Human Services, MongoDB, Comcast NBC Universal, Lattice, Wise (fka Transferwise), Checkr, and incident.io among others.

product.name: Credal Secure AI Agent Platform
product.description: A platform to build and deploy AI agents that integrate with enterprise data and tools while enforcing data security and access controls.

product.name: Data Integrations and Connectors
product.description: Pre-built and custom connectors to integrate enterprise data sources securely with AI applications, supporting real-time synchronization and permission inheritance.

product.name: Permission Synchronization and Access Control
product.description: A system that synchronizes and enforces granular access permissions across all connected data sources to prevent unauthorized AI data access.

product.name: PII Auto Redaction and Restoration
product.description: Automated detection and replacement of personally identifiable information (PII) with placeholders before data is sent to AI models, with the ability to restore original data afterward.

product.name: Audit Logging and Compliance Monitoring
product.description: Comprehensive logging and monitoring of AI interactions, including prompts, data accessed, and responses, to support compliance and security audits.

product.name: Action Release Gates
product.description: A control mechanism that enforces explicit verification steps when AI agents perform actions crossing permission boundaries to prevent sensitive data leakage.
